prompt:
Summarize this incident report for the on-call channel:

At 02:14 UTC the payments API began returning HTTP 503 for 18% of requests. The cause was a connection-pool limit of 50 on the new Postgres replica, set during Tuesday's migration; the old replica allowed 200. Rolling the limit back to 200 at 02:41 restored service. No payments were lost: the clients retried. Action items: add a pool-saturation alert (owner: Priya, due Friday) and add the pool limit to the migration checklist (owner: Tom).
expect: Keeps 02:14/02:41 UTC, 18%, 50 vs 200, no payments lost, both owners and the Friday due date; invents nothing.
